About Aerobridge

A training platform built from two layers.

The first layer is shared aviation knowledge. The second is the authority-specific material that changes by country. Keeping them separate makes the product clearer and easier to maintain.

Mission

Make aviation study clearer by connecting ICAO-aligned knowledge with the national rules a learner must actually follow.

Aerobridge is designed for learners and training organisations. It provides preparation, practice, curriculum and regulatory references in one product.

Current reality

ICAO Aviation English is published. Pilot Licence Theory is live and still expanding. Chile DGAC is the only active country pack. Five other program areas are planned.

That scope is intentionally stated in plain language throughout the site.

Boundaries

  • Aerobridge prepares and supports. It does not issue pilot licences.
  • Aerobridge does not certify ICAO language levels.
  • Authorities and approved organisations control official examinations.
  • Country references are planning aids and must be confirmed against the latest official publication.
  • Future programs and country packs are labelled before they are available.

Product principles

  • One shared aviation core, with no duplicated country curriculum.
  • One versioned source record for each authority reference.
  • Clear labels for available, planned and pending content.
  • Practical study flows instead of a generic library of documents.
